candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement forwarding the contract balance to the owner, so funds remain stuck in the contract instead of reaching owner.
Change the forwarded amount from the contract balance to zero, so the owner never receives the leftover balance.
Delete the statement calling the external target, so the forwarded value stays in the contract and is transferred to the owner instead.
Change the target of the external call to address(0), altering which contract receives the msg.value and whether the require passes.
Change the recipient of the final transfer from owner to msg.sender, so the leftover balance is refunded to the caller instead of the owner.
Delete the statement transferring the contract's remaining balance to the owner, so the owner no longer receives any payout after the call.
Pay msg.sender instead of the owner in the balance transfer, so leftover funds go to the caller rather than the owner.
Forward value 0 to the target call instead of msg.value, so the target receives nothing and the full amount remains for the owner payout.
Delete the require check on the call result, so go() no longer reverts when the external call to the target fails.
Transfer msg.value to the owner instead of the entire contract balance, changing the payout amount when the contract holds extra funds.
Delete the statement that transfers the remaining balance to the owner, so funds stay in the contract instead of being refunded.

Send only msg.value to the target instead of keeping the full balance logic, and still transfer full balance — actually replaced the transfer value: send the whole balance to the target rather than only msg.value.
Delete the require check so a failed call to the target no longer reverts and execution continues to refund the owner.
Refund msg.sender instead of the owner, so leftover funds go to the caller rather than the contract owner.
Remove the statement that sweeps the contract's remaining balance to the owner, so funds sent via go() remain in the contract.
Send the remaining balance to the target address instead of the owner.
Remove the require check on the call result so go() no longer reverts when the forward to target fails, changing revert/success behavior and onward balance flow.
Delete the statement that transfers the remaining balance to the owner, so leftover funds stay in the contract instead of going to the owner.
Change the forwarded value in the external call from msg.value to 0, so the entire msg.value remains in the contract and is transferred to the owner.
Delete the statement that transfers the contract's remaining balance to the owner, so no refund is sent after the external call.
Replace the refund transfer recipient `owner` with `msg.sender`, so any leftover balance goes to the caller instead of the owner.
Change the forwarded value in the external call from `msg.value` to the contract's entire balance, changing how much Ether the target receives.
Delete the `require(__sent_result100)` check so the function continues (and refunds the owner) even when the external call fails.
Replace the transfer to owner with a transfer back to the target, changing who receives the contract's remaining balance.
Delete the require check so a failed low-level call no longer reverts.
Delete the final transfer to owner so the contract retains its remaining balance.
Send address(this).balance instead of msg.value to the target, changing the amount forwarded.
Delete the statement transferring the remaining balance to the owner.
Replace transferring the contract's full balance with transferring only msg.value to the owner.
Delete the require check so failed calls to the target no longer revert.
